name: North-Star International Co., Ltd.
summary: North-Star International Co., Ltd. oversees a network of fuel stations across Taiwan. Beyond distributing various petroleum products, the company also provides automotive care services, such as vehicle cleaning, washing, and waxing. Originally founded in 1988 as North-Star Petroleum Co., Ltd., the enterprise adopted its current name, North-Star International Co., Ltd., in 2012. Its operational base is situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
